{{2025 Indian Premier League Teams|main=y}}

The [[2025 Indian Premier League]] was the 18th edition of the [[Indian Premier League]] (IPL), a professional [[Twenty20]] (T20) [[cricket]] league held in India, organized by the [[Board of Control for Cricket in India]] (BCCI). It has been held annually since the [[2008 Indian Premier League|first edition in 2008]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Premier League |url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/Indian-Premier-League |access-date=22 March 2025 |website=[[Britannica.com]] |language=en-uk|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250317155833/https://www.britannica.com/topic/Indian-Premier-League|archive-date=17 March 2025|url-status=live}}</ref> In July 2024, the [[Indian Premier League#Organization|IPL Governing Council]] held a meeting with the owners of the franchises and announced that a mega auction would be conducted ahead of the 2025 season.<ref>{{cite news|date=31 July 2024|title=IPL Owners Meeting – Update|url=https://www.iplt20.com/news/4107/ipl-owners-meeting-update|access-date=28 October 2024|website=[[IPLT20.com]]|archive-date=27 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127050427/https://www.iplt20.com/news/4107/ipl-owners-meeting-update|url-status=live}}</ref> It was the sixth mega auction after [[List of 2008 Indian Premier League auctions and personnel signings|2008]], [[List of 2011 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2011]], [[List of 2014 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2014]], [[List of 2018 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2018]] and [[List of 2022 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2022]].<ref>{{cite web|date=10 September 2024|title=IPL 2025 Mega Auction: Date, time, venue, and what to expect|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/sports/ipl-2025-mega-auction-date-time-venue-and-what-to-expect/3606613|access-date=30 September 2024|work=[[Financial Express (India)|Financial Express]]|archive-date=7 October 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007090811/https://www.financialexpress.com/sports/ipl-2025-mega-auction-date-time-venue-and-what-to-expect/3606613/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=30 September 2024|title=BCCI considering holding IPL 2025 auction overseas: Rajeev Shukla|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/ipl-auction-rajeev-shukla-overseas-2608899-2024-09-30|access-date=30 September 2024|work=[[India Today]]|archive-date=30 September 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930181949/https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/ipl-auction-rajeev-shukla-overseas-2608899-2024-09-30|url-status=live}}</ref>

The franchises were required to submit their retention lists before 31 October 2024, and a total of 46 players were retained ahead of the auction. The auction was held on 24 and 25 November 2024 in [[Jeddah]], Saudi Arabia, with the auction purse for each franchise set at {{INRConvert|120|c}}, the highest in the history of the IPL. A total of 1,574 players registered for the auction, of which 574 players were shortlisted to feature in the auction and 182 were sold in the auction. [[Rishabh Pant]] became the most expensive player in the history of IPL when he was bought by the [[Lucknow Super Giants]] for {{INRConvert|27|c}},<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 November 2024 |title=IPL mega auction: Franchises break the bank as Rishabh Pant becomes the most expensive bid |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/ipl-mega-auction-franchises-break-the-bank-as-rishabh-pant-becomes-the-most-expensive-bid/articleshow/115640033.cms |access-date=26 November 2024 |work=[[The Times of India]] |language=en |archive-date=26 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241126012442/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/ipl-mega-auction-franchises-break-the-bank-as-rishabh-pant-becomes-the-most-expensive-bid/articleshow/115640033.cms |url-status=live}}</ref> surpassing {{INRConvert|26.75|c}} paid by the [[Punjab Kings]] for [[Shreyas Iyer]] earlier in the same auction,<ref>{{Cite web |date=24 November 2024 |title=IPL auction: Rishabh Pant breaks Shreyas Iyer's record, sold for Rs 27 crore to LSG |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/cricket-ipl-auction-rishabh-pant-record-costliest-lucknow-delhi-war-2639282-2024-11-24 |access-date=26 November 2024 |work=[[India Today]] |language=en |archive-date=24 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241124143359/https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/cricket-ipl-auction-rishabh-pant-record-costliest-lucknow-delhi-war-2639282-2024-11-24 |url-status=live }}</ref> and {{INRConvert|24.75|c}} paid by the [[Kolkata Knight Riders]] for [[Mitchell Starc]] in the [[List of 2024 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2024 auction]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-11-24 |title=IPL 2025 Auction: Shreyas Iyer hits the jackpot, smashes Mitchell Starc's record with Rs 26.75 cr deal|url=https://www.economictimes.com/news/sports/ipl-2025-auction-shreyas-iyer-sold-to-punjab-kings-for-rs-26-75-crore-most-expensive-player-in-ipl-history/articleshow/115623365.cms |access-date=2024-11-26 |work=[[The Economic Times]]|language=en}}</ref> [[Vaibhav Sooryavanshi]] became the youngest player sold in the IPL history at the age of 13 years, being bought by the [[Rajasthan Royals]] for {{INRConvert|1.1|c}}.<ref>{{cite web|publisher=[[Cricinfo]]|url= https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-auction-rajasthan-royals-bag-vaibhav-suryavanshi-for-1-10-crore-1461735|date=25 November 2024|accessdate=26 November 2024|title= Bihar's Suryavanshi becomes youngest IPL player at just 13}}</ref>

Following the IPL's [[2025 Indian Premier League#Suspension and rescheduling|suspension and rescheduling]], it was announced that the franchises were allowed to sign temporary replacement players in place of unavailable players as the rescheduled fixtures clashed with the [[International cricket in 2025|international cricket calendar]], notably [[West Indian cricket team in Ireland in 2025|the West Indies' tour of Ireland]], [[West Indian cricket team in England in 2025|the West Indies' tour of England]] and [[2025 World Test Championship final|the World Test Championship final]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-13 |title=IPL 2025: Can teams sign replacements for players leaving on international duty mid-season? |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-news/ipl-2025-restart-player-replacement-rules-mid-season-international-duty-england-vs-west-indies/article69572248.ece |access-date=2025-05-24 |work=[[Sportstar]] |language=en |archive-date=16 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250616014109/https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-news/ipl-2025-restart-player-replacement-rules-mid-season-international-duty-england-vs-west-indies/article69572248.ece |url-status=live }}</ref> These temporary replacement players were not available for [[List of 2026 Indian Premier League personnel changes|retention in the 2026 auction]].<ref>{{cite web |date=30 October 2024 |title=IPL to allow temporary replacements for last leg of 2025 season |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-to-allow-franchises-sign-temporary-replacement-players-for-last-leg-of-2025-season-1485918 |access-date=23 May 2025 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=IPL Allows Temporary Replacements Amid Rescheduled Matches, Foreign Players' Non-Availability |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/sports/cricket/ipl-allows-temporary-replacements-considering-non-availability-of-a-few-foreign-players-3540685 |access-date=2025-05-24 |work=[[Deccan Herald]] |language=en |archive-date=31 July 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250731064229/https://www.deccanherald.com/sports/cricket/ipl-allows-temporary-replacements-considering-non-availability-of-a-few-foreign-players-3540685 |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Player retention ==
=== Retention policy ===
The ten franchises were allowed to retain a maximum of six players each from their squad, the highest number allowed before any of the mega auctions. The six players could consist of a maximum of five [[capped]] players (including Indian and overseas players) and two uncapped players.<ref>{{cite web|date=29 September 2024|title=IPL 2025 mega auction salary purse, retention rules, and RTM explained|url=https://www.business-standard.com/cricket/news/ipl-2025-mega-auction-salary-purse-retention-rules-and-rtm-explained-124092900134_1.html|access-date=29 September 2024|work=[[Business Standard]]|archive-date=30 September 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930015913/https://www.business-standard.com/cricket/news/ipl-2025-mega-auction-salary-purse-retention-rules-and-rtm-explained-124092900134_1.html|url-status=live}}</ref> The auction purse for each franchise was set at {{INRConvert|120|c}}, the highest in the history of the IPL.<ref>{{cite web |title=IPL 2025 Mega Auction: Report Says Franchise Purse To Increase From Rs 90 Crore to 120 Crore |url=https://sports.ndtv.com/cricket/ipl-governing-council-to-meet-on-saturday-evening-set-to-finalise-auction-retention-rule-6670161 |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[NDTV Sports]] |archive-date=1 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241001020644/https://sports.ndtv.com/cricket/ipl-governing-council-to-meet-on-saturday-evening-set-to-finalise-auction-retention-rule-6670161 |url-status=live}}</ref> Franchises were deducted a specific amount from the auction purse for every retained player. Franchises who did not retain the maximum number of players were allowed [[Indian Premier League#Players|Right-to-Match]] (RTM) cards at the auction.<ref>{{cite web |title=Franchises can now retain record number of players ahead of IPL 2025 auction, purse size gets bigger too; check all details here |url=https://thesportstak.com/cricket/indian-premier-league-22-mar-2024/story/franchises-can-now-retain-5-players-with-1-rtm-card-ahead-of-ipl-2025-auction-purse-size-gets-bigger-check-all-details-here-3101224-2024-09-28 |access-date=1 October 2024 |website=sportstak.com |date=28 September 2024 |archive-date=7 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241007090833/https://thesportstak.com/cricket/indian-premier-league-22-mar-2024/story/franchises-can-now-retain-5-players-with-1-rtm-card-ahead-of-ipl-2025-auction-purse-size-gets-bigger-check-all-details-here-3101224-2024-09-28 |url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Retained players ===
The franchises were required to submit their retention lists before 31 October 2024.<ref>{{cite web |title=Deadline For Submission Of Retention List For IPL 2025 Auction Revealed |url=https://news.abplive.com/sports/cricket/list-of-retained-released-players-for-ipl-2025-mega-auction-announced-check-date-1720752 |access-date=29 September 2024 |work=[[ABP News]] |date=29 September 2024 |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930020104/https://news.abplive.com/sports/cricket/list-of-retained-released-players-for-ipl-2025-mega-auction-announced-check-date-1720752 |url-status=live}}</ref>

== Auction ==
Any player willing to play in the IPL was required to register for the auction. Players who did not register for the mega auction would become ineligible to participate in the mini-auctions held in subsequent years.<ref>{{cite web |date=29 April 2024 |title=IPL 2025: The logic behind Rs 18 crore cap on foreign players and why they have to register for this year's auction |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-retention-foreign-player-register-9594869/ |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[The Indian Express]] |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930211005/https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-retention-foreign-player-register-9594869/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Any auctioned player withdrawing before the season without legitimate reason or injury would be banned from the IPL for a period of two years.<ref>{{cite web |title=Two-year ban for overseas players pulling out after being picked at IPL auction |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-two-year-ban-for-overseas-players-pulling-out-after-being-picked-at-auction-1453019 |access-date=1 October 2024 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]] |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930194531/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-two-year-ban-for-overseas-players-pulling-out-after-being-picked-at-auction-1453019 |url-status=live}}</ref> Any Indian capped player who had not been named in the [[Starting lineup|starting XI]] in [[international cricket]] ([[Test cricket|Test]], [[One Day International|ODI]], [[Twenty20 International|T20I]]) in the preceding five calendar years or did not have a central contract with the BCCI was considered as an uncapped player for the auction.<ref>{{cite web|title=Decks cleared for 'uncapped' Dhoni to be retained |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-rule-change-allows-csk-option-of-retaining-ms-dhoni-as-uncapped-player-1453028 |access-date=1 October 2024 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]] |archive-date=1 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241001005749/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-rule-change-allows-csk-option-of-retaining-ms-dhoni-as-uncapped-player-1453028 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=29 September 2024 |title=MS Dhoni as uncapped player? IPL's revived rule will not just benefit CSK |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/ipl-uncapped-player-retention-rule-ms-dhoni-all-teams-aakash-chopra-2608167-2024-09-29 |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[India Today]] |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930200035/https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/cricket/story/ipl-uncapped-player-retention-rule-ms-dhoni-all-teams-aakash-chopra-2608167-2024-09-29 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=28 September 2024|title=3 IPL franchises apart from CSK who can benefit from BCCI bringing back uncapped player rule|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/3-india-stars-apart-from-ms-dhoni-who-can-benefit-from-bcci-bringing-back-uncapped-player-rule-in-ipl-101727589573331.html|access-date=29 September 2024|work=[[The Hindustan Times]]|issn=0971-8257|archive-date=1 October 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241001132447/https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/3-india-stars-apart-from-ms-dhoni-who-can-benefit-from-bcci-bringing-back-uncapped-player-rule-in-ipl-101727589573331.html|url-status=live}}</ref> The salary cap of a player would consist of auction purse, incremental performance pay and match fees. Each playing member (including the [[Impact player (cricket)|impact player]]) would get a match fee of {{INRConvert|7.5|l}} in addition to the auctioned price.<ref>{{cite web|date=29 September 2024 |title=Franchise purse for IPL 2025 auction and the new 'match fee' component |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/explained-franchise-purse-for-ipl-2025-auction-and-the-new-match-fee-component/articleshow/113777845.cms |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[The Times of India]] |issn=0971-8257 |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930170544/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/explained-franchise-purse-for-ipl-2025-auction-and-the-new-match-fee-component/articleshow/113777845.cms |url-status=live}}</ref>

The auction was held on 24 and 25 November 2024 in [[Jeddah]], Saudi Arabia.<ref>{{cite web|title=IPL 2025 mega auction to be held on November 24, 25 in Jeddah|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-auction-on-november-24-25-in-jeddah-1458546|access-date=5 November 2024|publisher=[[Cricinfo]]|archive-date=16 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241116185000/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-auction-on-november-24-25-in-jeddah-1458546|url-status=live}}</ref> [[Mallika Sagar]] was appointed as the [[auctioneer]] for the second consecutive time after she hosted the [[List of 2024 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2024 auction]].<ref>{{cite web|date=15 November 2024|title=Mallika Sagar to conduct IPL 2025 mega auction in Jeddah|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/mallika-sagar-ipl-2025-mega-auction-host/articleshow/115334563.cms|access-date=16 November 2024|work=[[The Times of India]]|issn=0971-8257|archive-date=16 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241116011547/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/mallika-sagar-ipl-2025-mega-auction-host/articleshow/115334563.cms|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=15 November 2024|title=IPL 2025 Auction in Jeddah: Mallika Sagar returns as auctioneer|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/sports/ipl-2025-auction-in-jeddah-mallika-sagar-returns-as-auctioneer/articleshow/115336276.cms?from=mdr|access-date=16 November 2024|work=[[The Economic Times]]|issn=0013-0389|archive-date=15 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241115130156/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/sports/ipl-2025-auction-in-jeddah-mallika-sagar-returns-as-auctioneer/articleshow/115336276.cms?from=mdr|url-status=live}}</ref> A total of 1,574 players registered for the auction,<ref name="List">{{cite web |title=1574 players register for TATA IPL 2025 Player Auction|url=https://www.iplt20.com/news/4111/1574-players-register-for-tata-ipl-2025-player-auction|access-date=5 November 2024|website=[[IPLT20.com]]|archive-date=11 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241111155920/https://www.iplt20.com/news/4111/1574-players-register-for-tata-ipl-2025-player-auction|url-status=live}}</ref> of which 574 players were shortlisted to feature in the auction.<ref name="List2">{{cite web|title=TATA IPL 2025 Player Auction List Announced|url=https://www.iplt20.com/news/4112/tata-ipl-2025-player-auction-list-announced|access-date=15 November 2024|website=[[IPLT20.com]]|archive-date=22 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241122145217/https://www.iplt20.com/news/4112/tata-ipl-2025-player-auction-list-announced|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Sold players ===
Two sets of marquee players went up for bidding first followed by 15 sets of players divided based on their specialisation: [[Batting (cricket)|batters]], [[all-rounder]]s, [[wicket keeper batter]]s, [[Fast bowling|fast bowlers]] and [[Spin bowling|spin bowlers]]; and status: [[capped]] and uncapped. After player no. 116, the auction entered its accelerated phase, covering all the remaining players. During the accelerated round, players were presented based on the franchises' preference.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-auction-2025-time-date-and-everything-you-need-to-know-espncricinfo-1458820|title=IPL auction 2025 – Time, date, and details of marquee player sets|date=8 November 2024|access-date=15 January 2026|publisher=[[Cricinfo]]|archive-date=20 February 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220155905/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-auction-2025-time-date-and-everything-you-need-to-know-espncricinfo-1458820|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-11-24 |title=IPL auction 2025 rules: RTM card, accelerated auction, base price process explained – All you need to know |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-rules-rtm-card-accelerated-auction-base-price-process-explained-all-you-need-to-know-101732432049058.html |access-date=2026-01-15 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |language=en |archive-date=24 November 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241124074744/https://www.hindustantimes.com/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-rules-rtm-card-accelerated-auction-base-price-process-explained-all-you-need-to-know-101732432049058.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Withdrawn players ==
The following players were ruled out and/or unavailable for the rest of the season due to either injury or national duties. The franchises were allowed to pick a replacement player from the unsold players at the auction to replace the withdrawn players.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-14 |title=Explained: The Updated IPL Player Replacement Rules Ahead Of Resumption |url=https://www.wisden.com/series/ipl-2025/cricket-news/explained-the-updated-ipl-player-replacement-rules-after-leagues-suspension |access-date=2026-01-15 |website=Wisden |language=en |archive-date=16 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250516113751/https://www.wisden.com/series/ipl-2025/cricket-news/explained-the-updated-ipl-player-replacement-rules-after-leagues-suspension |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-05-14 |title=IPL 2025: Jamie Overton withdraws as league revises replacement rules |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/articles/c5ygdzepxlqo |access-date=2026-01-15 |website=[[BBC Sport]] |language=en-GB |archive-date=15 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250515033814/https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/articles/c5ygdzepxlqo |url-status=live }}</ref>
